title: Grateful Dead Live at Bangor Municipal Auditorium on 1971-04-22

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a short but high‑energy Bangor show with standout performances of Hard To Handle, Cumberland Blues and Next Time You See Me.
ai_review.review: The recording is a pristine SBD mix that lets the tight, upbeat playing of the spring‑71 Dead shine through.  Even though the set was cut short by a looming power shut‑off, the band stayed in the pocket, delivering memorable versions of Hard To Handle, Cumberland Blues, China > Rider and Garcia’s heartfelt Sing Me Back Home.  Reviewers consistently praise both the musical fire and the crystal‑clear sound.

ai_rating.rationale: All 13 reviews are overwhelmingly positive, highlighting a tight performance and an excellent soundboard mix; the only downside is the short runtime, which does not materially affect enjoyment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the SBD mix "perfect", "crisp" and "super 71 soundboard"; no complaints about drop‑outs, muddiness or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short set (power cut) but well‑sequenced; tight first set ending on Casey Jones, a strong second set with smooth transitions (e.g., China/Rider) and high audience engagement.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for solid guitar work, vocal performance, and his steel‑guitar cameo with NRPS; noted as upset when power was cut.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned as sharing the setlist evenly with Jerry and Pigpen; solid rhythm guitar throughout.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ highlighted on Hard To Handle, Good Lovin' and Next Time You See Me; no specific comment about a separate keyboardist.
